items.title: Una falla técnica de Delta provoca retrasos y suspensiones de vuelos en el centro de operaciones de Atlanta
items.author: Sri Taylor, Jessica Nix
items.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc. suspendió temporalmente las salidas en su centro de operaciones de Atlanta el domingo después de que una falla tecnológica provocara retrasos y cancelaciones que se extendieron po ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Delta Air Lines Inc. suspendió temporalmente las salidas en su centro de operaciones de Atlanta el domingo después de que una falla tecnológica provocara retrasos y cancelaciones que se extendieron por toda su red; se trata del más reciente fallo de sistemas que ha complicado el tráfico aéreo en EE.UU. tras la suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional a principios de este mes. La suspensión de salidas, que comenzó la madrugada del domingo, pasó a un programa de retrasos en tierra antes de que se levantaran ambas restricciones, según Delta. La aerolínea indicó que los empleados estaban utilizando soluciones manuales mientras los técnicos trabajaban para restablecer el sistema automatizado que se utiliza para calcular el peso y el equilibrio de las aeronaves, un paso crítico en la preparación de los vuelos para su salida. “Los equipos de Delta están utilizando soluciones manuales esta mañana para garantizar que los vuelos despeguen de manera segura mientras continúan los trabajos para restablecer el sistema automatizado”, dijo un portavoz de la empresa en un comunicado. VER MÁS: EE.UU. suspende todos los vuelos por problemas de comunicación en el control del tráfico aéreo La interrupción causó retrasos significativos durante la hora pico de la mañana en el Aeropuerto Internacional Hartsfield-Jackson de Atlanta, el centro de operaciones más grande de Delta. Solo el 50% de los vuelos de Delta programados para salir a las 7 a. m. partieron dentro de los 15 minutos siguientes a sus horarios programados, según la firma de análisis de aviación Cirium. Esa cifra cayó a alrededor del 46% para las salidas programadas a las 9 a. m., antes de recuperarse al 100% para los 65 vuelos programados para salir a las 10 a. m. Los problemas se extendieron al Aeropuerto LaGuardia de Nueva York, donde 42 vuelos de Delta con destino a ese aeropuerto fueron desviados a otros destinos el domingo por la mañana, según Cirium. Seis vuelos fueron redirigidos a Albany, Nueva York; otros seis, a Filadelfia; y cinco, a Siracusa. La aerolínea y sus filiales regionales también sufrieron una oleada de cancelaciones en LaGuardia, donde nueve de los 18 vuelos programados para salir a las 8 a. m. fueron cancelados o no operaron, junto con cinco de los 16 vuelos programados para las 9 a. m. Para los viajeros, esta interrupción significó horas de incertidumbre y cambios repetidos en los horarios de salida. Natalie Pfister, de 39 años, una agente fotográfica que viajaba a Charleston con su esposo y su hijo pequeño para pasar unas vacaciones, estaba sopesando si abandonar sus planes y volver a reservar para el lunes después de que su vuelo de Delta se retrasara cuatro horas. La aerolínea había pospuesto la hora de salida al menos tres veces, lo que dejó a la familia de Manhattan sin saber si finalmente volarían. “Cuando empiezan a retrasar y retrasar y retrasar, por lo general Delta cancela”, dijo Pfister. “Viajar por Estados Unidos es simplemente una pesadilla”. Otros pasajeros se mostraron más resignados ante la interrupción. Los jubilados Tom y Nancy Malloy, que regresaban a Florida después de un evento familiar en Nueva York, enfrentaron un retraso de dos horas y media en su vuelo a Tampa. Nancy describió los retrasos como “algo habitual al viajar hoy en día”, aunque elogió a Delta por mantener informados a los pasajeros. La pareja había atribuido inicialmente la interrupción a la niebla en el área de Nueva York y no estaban al tanto de los problemas tecnológicos en Atlanta. Esta interrupción es la más reciente de una serie de contratiempos en el transporte aéreo de EE.UU. United Airlines Holdings Inc. sufrió una falla generalizada de sus sistemas el 16 de noviembre que retrasó los vuelos de salida, apenas unos días después de que una falla de telecomunicaciones en una instalación de la Administración Federal de Aviación provocara una suspensión de vuelos a nivel nacional. La interrupción del 13 de noviembre obligó a las aerolíneas a cancelar miles de vuelos y agravó las presiones financieras sobre una industria que ya se enfrentaba a elevados costos de combustible. items.body:
News
/ Benzinga
/ AI Rout Turns Gold Into Source Of Cash: What Comes Next?

AI Rout Turns Gold Into Source Of Cash: What Comes Next? 2 min read

QQQ NEM B AEM
Gold fell to a 14-month low on Friday as a rout in technology shares prompted investors to sell bullion to cover losses elsewhere. The metal slid alongside falling Treasury yields and the US dollar.
Spot gold fell to $3,502 an ounce- the lowest level since September 2025. In total, bullion lost 8.9% for the week, while the Invesco QQQ ETF QQQ sank 9.31% and State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF (NYSE:SPY) fell by 7.98%, entering correction territory
Rate Hike Bets Set the Stage
Minutes from the Federal Reserve’s October meeting showed that nearly all policymakers anticipated further rate increases . According to the CME FedWatch , traders currently price in an 88.6% chance of a quarter-point increase in December.
“The ongoing AI-related equity selloff is prompting some forced liquidations of gold positions to cover losses,” David Meger , director of metals trading at High Ridge Futures, told Reuters.
Ole Hansen , head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, wrote that bullion “has become a source of cash for investors facing mounting losses elsewhere,” Mining.com reported.
In a market commentary, former Bridgewater economist Bob Elliott said pro-growth pricing “remains quite elevated” and warned the selloff could become “more self-reinforcing to the downside.”
Once downturns start, he wrote, they typically require “both much cheaper pricing and some sort of policy support to get to the bottom, neither of which we are at yet.”
Interestingly, there was little sign of a broad exit from gold funds. Holdings in gold ETFs tracked by Bloomberg were little changed over the preceding month despite a roughly 10% drop in bullion, Hansen said.
Mining shares were less resilient, since their leverage to gold price works both ways. The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (NYSE:GDX) closed the week 14.80% below the previous Friday’s close. The largest names in the sector, Newmont NEM , Barrick Mining B and Agnico Eagle Mines AEM lost 15.03%, 15.19% and 13.64%, respectively.
Technical Outlook
Gold’s daily chart shows the magnitude of the post-summer carnage. After peaking in August and briefly moving above the 200-day moving average, bullion reversed course and fell by over 25%.

Gold, daily chart, Source: TradingView
Zooming out, the next key support area is the Q2-Q3 2025 price range. For much of that time, price remained in a tight accumulation between $3,200 and $3,450.
Thus, price could easily fall further, test that range, and wait for the next catalyst to move it either way.

WASHINGTON, Nov 22 : Americans should expect more technology outages and disruptions as companies and government agencies replace aging systems, the top US intelligence official said on Sunday.
"And as part of that ongoing upgrade, we are going to have glitches, gaps, interruptions in service," Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNN's "State of the Union" program. "That is going to happen."
Clayton was interviewed on Sunday morning news programs days after President Donald Trump attributed a recent spate of technology failures to upgrades of companies' technology systems. Clayton said the upgrades were necessary to improve performance and cybersecurity as technological advances strain older systems.
A string of technology failures this month disrupted critical US systems, including a nationwide halt to air travel, a Microsoft outage that hit email services, a technical glitch that affected several major banks and a temporary disruption to the National Security Agency's network.

Clayton declined to discuss specifics of separate reports of cyberattacks on the FBI and Department of Agriculture, saying he expects investigators to provide answers "in due course."

By Jack Queen
NEW YORK, Nov 22 (Reuters) – The US Army will detonate 68 barrels of toxic lead azide in Iowa by Tuesday under emergency legal powers that allow it to bypass a court order blocking the controversial plan, the Trump administration told a court this weekend. 

“The Army must perform a controlled detonation to protect the public from the more significant threat from an uncontrolled explosion, and the Army intends to act by November 24, 2026,” the Justice Department said in a court filing late on Saturday. 

The US Court of Appeals for the 8th Circuit temporarily halted the detonation by freezing the Army’s environmental permit on Thursday after environmental groups sued to halt the operation. The government said in Saturday night’s filing that the Army plans to move forward without a permit by invoking an emergency munitions and explosives exception to federal environmental protection laws. 

Show Full Article

Federal officials say the detonation must go forward within the next several days because a drop in temperatures could destabilize the material and cause an uncontrolled explosion. 

The Army previously postponed plans to detonate the degraded lead azide, an explosive used in military munitions, after public outcry by residents and farmers near Middletown, Iowa. 

The Army did not immediately respond to an inquiry on Sunday about the precise timing of the detonation. 

The Iowa Environmental Council and the Sierra Club’s Iowa chapter filed the lawsuit. Earthjustice, a nonprofit environmental law organization suing on behalf of the groups, did not immediately respond to an email on Sunday seeking comment. 

The plaintiffs have argued that the detonations would release a toxic plume of lead dust into the air that could travel 100 miles (161 kilometers) north of the site, depending on weather conditions.

In a statement on Thursday, acting Secretary of the Army Adam Telle said the Army had determined with the US Environmental Protection Agency that a controlled detonation to dispose of the degraded lead was the option that posed the lowest risk to the public.

Lead exposure can cause serious health problems, particularly in children, including damage to the brain and nervous system.

The Army has advised people to avoid the affected area during the detonation and urged anyone who could not leave beforehand to stay indoors, close windows and doors and shut off heating and cooling systems. Residents should wet-clean surfaces children may touch to remove any lead dust once the exposure period has ended, the Army said. 

The Iowa Department of Agriculture and Land Stewardship has recommended that cattle farmers near the detonation site move their livestock, feed and equipment to alternate locations or indoors.

(Reporting by Jack Queen in New York; Editing by Sergio Non and Bill Berkrot)

items.title: Bitget UEX Daily | Nasdaq Slumps as Nvidia Probe Adds to AI Selloff; Bitcoin Reclaims $60,000 Over the Weekend (November 23, 2026)
items.summary: I. Hot News Highlights AI and Regulation: Nvidia Accounting Probe Adds Uncertainty On November 20, Reuters reported, citing sources, that the SEC was examin
items.body: I. Hot News Highlights AI and Regulation: Nvidia Accounting Probe Adds Uncertainty On November 20, Reuters reported, citing sources, that the SEC was examining Nvidia’s accounting. The specific issues remain undisclosed, and the investigation has not established wrongdoing. US Economy: Consumer Sentiment Improves as Inflation Expectations Ease The University of Michigan’s final November sentiment index rose to 51.5 from 48.0 in October. One-year inflation expectations fell from 4.7% to 3.7%, while longer-term expectations declined from 3.5% to 3.3%; sentiment nevertheless remains weak, with inflation a leading concern. Resilient demand and easing price expectations can coexist. Actual spending and PCE data must now test that combination; the survey alone does not establish that interest-rate pressure has cleared. Weekend Policy: Chinese Exchanges Ease Margin Requirements On November 22, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges announced that the minimum financing margin ratio would fall from 100% to 80% on November 30. Shanghai and Shenzhen also announced fee reductions, with Monday’s turnover and market response providing an initial test of their impact. II. Market Review Market Moves Explained Market performance: The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday, the S&P 500 lost 3.70%, and the Dow dropped 1.93%, with all seven megacaps lower. Nvidia fell 14.01%, AMD and Micron each lost more than 13%, while CoreWeave and Nebius declined 12.02% and 16.11%; bitcoin touched roughly $55,252 over the weekend before reclaiming $60,000. First, investors are questioning who ultimately funds AI spending. Strong chip sales demonstrate infrastructure demand, but do not establish that cloud providers and model companies have earned adequate returns. If end-user revenue fails to cover compute, power and financing costs, expansion becomes more dependent on continued access to capital. Second, high rates pressure both valuations and project economics. Companies with distant profits and substantial funding needs face higher financing costs and lower present values for future cash flow. The sharper declines in neocloud stocks are consistent with investors differentiating funding capacity and cash-flow quality. Third, risks at a market leader spread through crowded positions. Nvidia’s decline weakened a key valuation anchor for chips, cloud infrastructure and related equipment. Treasury yields fell on Friday without arresting the technology selloff, suggesting that exposure reduction also mattered beyond the day’s rate move. Commodities and Foreign Exchange Asset Reference level Basis Spot gold $3,520.09/oz Friday, late New York session Spot silver $40.95/oz Friday, late New York session WTI crude $83.41/bbl January 2027 contract, Friday closing reference Brent crude $92.57/bbl January 2027 contract, Friday settlement US Dollar Index 103.81 Friday closing reference US 10-year Treasury yield 4.912% Friday closing reference Precious metals weakened alongside risk assets, while Treasuries attracted some support. Oil recovered on Friday, and the weekend attack on an industrial facility in Bahrain kept supply risks in focus alongside demand concerns. Cryptocurrency Performance BTC traded at 60,940.92 USDT, up 1.05% over 24 hours; ETH stood at 1,712.92 USDT, up 1.35%. Total crypto market capitalization was approximately $2.11 trillion, down 2.18%, with 24-hour volume of $62.53 billion; aggregate data were updated at 22:55 Beijing time on November 22. BTC | Liquidation Zones: A conspicuous potential short-liquidation cluster lies around $61,400–$62,300, approximately 0.86%–2.34% above the current price; the lower potential long-liquidation cluster is around $60,000–$60,600, approximately 0.45%–1.43% below. The lower zone is closer, making a retreat into it relevant for potential liquidation-driven volatility. ETH | Liquidation Zones: A conspicuous potential short-liquidation cluster lies around $1,720–$1,740, approximately 0.52%–1.69% above the current price; the lower potential long-liquidation cluster is around $1,675–$1,695, approximately 0.94%–2.11% below. The upper zone is closer, where short liquidations could accelerate a rebound. Institutional Cost Basis | BTC: Strategy disclosed on November 16 that it held 850,849 BTC as of November 15, at an average acquisition cost of approximately $75,452 including fees. Bitcoin is about 19.32% below that cost; this is a price-to-acquisition-cost comparison, not the company’s overall financial return. Market Takeaway: Watch BTC buying interest around $60,000–$60,600 and follow-through above $61,400, alongside ETH’s response around $1,720–$1,740. Monday’s equities and ETF flows will help assess whether the weekend recovery can extend. Major US Indices Index Close Daily change Dow Jones 48,147.33 -1.93% S&P 500 6,910.39 -3.70% Nasdaq Composite 22,617.73 -5.28% The S&P 500 and Dow are both more than 10% below their record closing highs, meeting the usual definition of a correction. The S&P’s seventh consecutive decline shows that pressure extends beyond one company. Magnificent Seven Company Close (USD) Daily change Nvidia (NVDA) 125.53 -14.01% Apple (AAPL) 342.56 -1.90% Microsoft (MSFT) 484.52 -2.77% Alphabet (GOOGL) 265.29 -2.70% Amazon (AMZN) 246.82 -4.10% Meta (META) 560.84 -5.93% Tesla (TSLA) 345.82 -7.64% All seven fell, led by Nvidia and Tesla, while Apple was relatively resilient. Watch whether selling spreads further into steadier cash-flow businesses and whether any leader-led rebound broadens across the sector. Sector Moves Semiconductors and cloud infrastructure: AMD lost 13.25% and Micron declined 13.89%, alongside sharp neocloud losses. Distinguish actual orders and project financing from any subsequent stock-price recovery. Crypto-linked equities: Strategy fell 9.67%, Coinbase lost 6.34%, and Robinhood declined 9.44% at Friday’s close. Whether the weekend crypto rebound carries into these stocks remains a question for Monday’s opening. Stock-specific resilience: UnitedHealth gained 2.84%, alongside a TD Cowen upgrade from Hold to Buy. Individual catalysts still produced gains, but one stock does not establish a sector-wide reversal. III. In-Depth US Equity Analysis Nvidia (NVDA): Strong Earnings Meet a Higher Risk Discount Event overview: Shares closed at $125.53 on Friday, down 14.01%. Previously reported quarterly revenue reached $115.8 billion, up 103%, with next-quarter revenue guidance of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%. Market interpretation: Strong realized sales have not stabilized the stock. Customer funding, cash collection and project returns also affect the valuation investors will accept. Investment implications: Next-quarter gross-margin guidance of 71%–72% is below the roughly 75% reported last quarter. Watch product-ramp margins, receivables, cash flow and formal regulatory disclosures. Anthropic (ANT): IPO Premium Narrows as Execution Takes Focus Event overview: Shares fell 8.50% to $88.91 on Friday, remaining 7.12% above the $83 offering price. The second-day decline showed that IPO enthusiasm offered limited insulation from the AI selloff. Market interpretation: Model capability and commercial returns require separate assessment. Revenue growth needs to be evaluated alongside compute purchases, customer retention and cash consumption. Investment implications: The $83 offering price is a reference, not assured support. Enterprise monetization, unit compute costs and cash consumption will help assess whether growth improves operating cash flow. Intuit (INTU): Revised Growth Outlook Meets a Planned Divestiture Event overview: Shares fell 12.77% to $270.44 on Friday. Quarterly revenue rose 12% to $4.4 billion, and the company announced a planned $3.68 billion Mailchimp sale. Market interpretation: Full-year revenue growth guidance moved to 8%–9%, while operating-income and EPS guidance were maintained. Investors must reassess the durability of both sales growth and margin improvement. Investment implications: Closing is expected in early 2027, subject to approvals and other conditions; current guidance excludes the sale’s effects. Watch Credit Karma, completion and updated guidance before treating planned buybacks as realized benefits. IV. Market & Project Updates BTC ETF outflows persist. Reported US spot BTC ETF flows for November 16–20 totaled approximately $1.245 billion in net withdrawals, including $124.5 million reported for Friday. IBIT’s Friday figure remains missing, making the weekly total incomplete; the weekend price rebound does not establish renewed ETF inflows. Chainflip discloses stolen assets and recovery terms. The project says the November 21 incident involved roughly 122.86 BTC, 520.22 ETH and 4.0078 million USDC and USDT combined, and offered a 10% bounty for returning 90%. Watch recovery and service-restoration progress; initial single-chain estimates are not the final total loss. Prediction-market legislation advances. The Senate passed the DEATH BETS Act, which would prohibit CFTC-regulated entities from listing or clearing contracts involving war, assassination, terrorism or individual deaths. Further legislative steps remain, including the House; it is not an enacted ban. COP31 ends without a final agreement. The EU and others rejected the final draft on November 22 amid disagreements over fossil fuels and climate finance. The outcome adds policy uncertainty, without directly establishing stronger near-term oil and gas demand. V. Today’s Market Calendar Beijing time Country/region Event Focus November 23, all day Japan Labor Thanksgiving Day closure; no derivatives holiday trading ★★ November 23, 21:30 US October Chicago Fed National Activity Index ★★ November 23, 22:45 US November flash manufacturing, services and composite PMIs; one release ★★★ November 23, 23:00 US Chicago Fed Survey of Economic Conditions ★★ November 24, 02:00 US Two-year Treasury auction ★★★ Event preview: PMI new orders and prices will help assess demand and cost pressures, while the Treasury auction tests short-end demand. PCE, GDP and spending data follow this week; US stocks close for Thanksgiving on November 26 and finish early on November 27, potentially amplifying moves around concentrated releases and thinner holiday trading. Institutional view: On November 20, Cetera CIO Gene Goldman distinguished the earnings test passed by chipmakers from the valuation test facing AI listings. That distinction frames the week: can operating results support the price investors pay for future growth? For market information only; not investment advice.

items.title: Climate deal collapses in chaotic end to COP31
items.author: CNA
items.summary: COP31 talks in Antalya break down after nearly 200 nations fail to bridge splits over fossil fuels, leaving no cover decision and no US$120 billion climate goal.
items.body:

Climate deal collapses in chaotic end to COP31

COP31 talks in Antalya break down after nearly 200 nations fail to bridge splits over fossil fuels, leaving no cover decision and no US$120 billion climate goal.

COP31 President Murat Kurum speaks during the plenary session at the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye on Nov 22, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Murad Sezer)

ANTALYA: The COP31 climate talks ended in failure Sunday (Nov 22)  as a contentious deal collapsed over fossil fuels and the summit stretched into record overtime in Türkiye .
The final agreement was dramatically rejected in a chaotic finale to a UN climate summit which ran two days over schedule, underscoring the strains on diplomacy in an increasingly fractured world.
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who urged nations to send fossil fuels "the way of the dinosaurs" during a fiery appearance at COP31, expressed deep dismay as the talks broke down.
"I share the very profound frustration of all those who expected governments to rise to the moment the climate crisis demands," the outgoing UN chief said in a statement.

COP31 negotiations chair Chris Bowen, who unsuccessfully sought to broker consensus among nearly 200 nations, conceded he could not overcome what he called "unbridgeable red lines".
"Unfortunately, we were unable to reach agreement on a cover decision... And that's disappointing. Very disappointing," Bowen, who is Australia's climate minister, told a throng of reporters.
More than 49 hours after the summit was supposed to end, COP31 President and Turkish Environment Minister Murat Kurum banged the gavel to conclude the marathon talks.

COP31 President Murat Kurum, center, leaves a closing plenary session at the COP31 U.N. Climate Summit, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026, in Antalya, Turkey. (AP Photo/Khalil Hamra)

"GREENWASH" Bowen said the summit backdrop was "the most complicated and fraught geopolitical environment in living memory" as soaring energy prices and fallout from the Middle East war complicated the search for unity.
Under pressure to show progress in a year of climate-linked disasters from Europe to Nepal, Bowen sought an overarching "cover decision" to prove countries were still united in tackling the crisis.
But his plan unravelled as familiar fault lines emerged over fossil fuels, with the EU and Saudi Arabia locking horns over the pace of the shift away from coal, oil and gas.
The negotiations stalled as oil-producing states blocked any mention of phasing out fossil fuels in the final deal.
"We will not endorse a cover decision ... that does not even mention fossil fuels, which is the key driver of climate change," said Ireland's climate minister, Darragh O'Brien, whose country holds the rotating EU presidency.
"And we will not accept a COP that greenwashes fossil fuel."
Panama, Vanuatu and the Marshall Islands also objected and as the deal imploded, COP31 became the longest climate summit on record.

Related:

Fossil fuels still missing from latest COP31 draft deal

FALLING SHORT The outcome revived memories of the failed Copenhagen summit of 2009 and raised fresh doubts about the effectiveness of climate diplomacy.
"It certainly fell short today," said UN climate chief Simon Stiell, describing progress over the marathon fortnight of negotiations in Antalya as "limited".
"The world cannot afford a repeat."
Frustrated by the inertia, countries are pushing ahead outside the COP process.
Around 60 countries joined a first-of-its-kind conference in April on phasing out fossil fuels while several nations at COP31 unveiled their own plans to exit coal, oil and gas.
In a last-ditch bid for compromise, COP31 hosts Türkiye and Australia could only muster a veiled reference to fossil fuels in the final text.
But the pact also took fire for retaining a call to expand carbon capture - a costly technology championed by the fossil fuel industry.
"We believe that climate change requires all solutions on the table," said Mohammad Ayoub, a climate negotiator for oil giant Saudi Arabia.
Facing blowback over the fossil fuels omission, Türkiye and Australia tried to rally support behind a global goal to electrify the world economy.
They said "electrification" could cut heat-trapping emissions and bolster energy security but the target was ultimately torpedoed, along with the rest of the doomed Antalya Pact.

Related:

Climate crisis: COP31 president says there is no agreement on the draft text

"PROFOUND DISAPPOINTMENT" Countries lamented a missed opportunity to reinforce the Paris agreement's 1.5°C target, which scientists expect the world to overshoot in a few years as carbon-cutting goals fall short.
The summit also widened fault lines over science, with a fight over the work of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) spilling into the negotiations.
"We are profoundly disappointed by the substance of the cover decision," said UK climate negotiator Kate Hughes.
"It moves us backwards on the science ... It is a lowest common denominator where it should have been, instead, presenting bold collective ambition on climate action."
As always, the summit laid bare the divide between major polluters driving climate change and smaller nations bearing the brunt of its impact.
Developing nations pushed for a US$120 billion target climate goal which disappeared from the failed deal.

Source: Reuters/dc/fs

items.title: Nvidia Board Faces a Governance Reckoning
items.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg opinion columnist Gautam Mukunda tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia has exposed broader corporate governance problems, as the board faces outside pressure to bring him back while investigations and potential shareholder litigation loom. Mukunda argues that Silicon Valley’s tendency to concentrate power around founder CEOs can weaken oversight, while Huang’s exit also complicates the debate over whether the US should allow advanced Nvidia chips to be sold to China.  Nvidia has publicly said its board does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: アンソロピックＩＰＯ、銀行に異例の制約　競合担当禁止や人数制限
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 過去最大規模となった米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）。引き受け銀行は巨額の報酬を得たが、ＩＰＯの過程でアンソロピックが異例なほどの制約を銀行側にかけていたことが関係者の話で分かった。アンソロピックと並ぶ大型上場を遂げたスペースＸでも同様な状況だったという。

６月のスペースＸのＩＰＯでは、数カ月にわたる手続きをスペースＸが厳しく管理し、財務などの情報を開示しなかった。このためアドバイザーは業務を進めにくく、銀行の担当者らは不満を募らせた。

社内で「プロジェクト・ランタン」と呼ばれたアンソロピックのＩＰＯでも、銀行側は振り回された。直前の変更や財務見通しの共有の遅れ、慌ただしい書類承認、銀行に対する極めて異例の制約などだ。

関係者によると、アンソロピックは２２社の引受金融機関の一部に対し、案件に携わる要員を４人までに絞り、上級職員を充てるよう指示した。また銀行の一部の幹部に、法的文書への署名を求めた。案件チームの中核メンバーが上場後６カ月間、オープンＡＩ、カーソル、ディープシーク、ハギング・フェイスなどの競合企業と仕事をすることを制限する内容だった。

銀行は日常的に利益相反を管理し、顧客の機密を守っている。ＩＰＯでこれほどの制限を求めるのはまれで、まして銀行担当者個々に求めることは異例という。

＜情報漏えいに神経とがらす＞

こうした銀行に対する制約は、一つに情報漏えいを防ぐことが目的だった。

アンソロピックが米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に提出した届出書「フォームＳ─１」が公開される４週間近く前に、ロイターはその内容を報じた。

アンソロピックは、案件を引き受けた大半の銀行との情報共有に、通常のＰＤＦではなく「ネットロードショー」と呼ばれるサービスを使った。

ネットロードショーは、誰が文書を閲覧し、どのページを見たかといったアクセスの詳細を記録する。ネットロードショー上の文書には、バンカー個人の名前が透かしとして入った。

その後もＩＰＯ書類に関する報道は続いた。関係者の１人によると、ネットロードショーの利用で銀行側の業務は煩雑になった。文書のコピーを保存できないことなどが理由だ。

アンソロピックは１０日に仮条件を記載した修正届出書「Ｓ─１Ａ」をＳＥＣに提出し、販売活動を始める予定だった。そのためには、シンジケート団の全銀行に草案を送り、承認を得る必要があるが、送付を巡って混乱があり、銀行側に届け出書がＳ─１Ａがネットロードショー経由で送られたのはニューヨーク時間午前２時ごろ。ＳＥＣへの提出に向け、銀行側に、承認のために与えられた時間は数時間しかなかったという。

銀行担当者からは「手続きが複雑な問題だらけで、これまで手掛けたどの案件とも違っていた」との声が出ている。

ＩＰＯを研究するフロリダ大学のジェイ・リッター名誉教授によると、スペースＸとアンソロピックはいずれも交渉により、グリーンシューオプション（追加売り出し）で売却する追加株式について、引受会社に手数料を一切支払わないことを取り付けた。「これらの企業には確かに、引受会社に対して『いつも通りにはいかない』と告げるだけの市場支配力があった」と指摘した。

アンソロピック、および両ＩＰＯで主幹事を務めたゴールドマン・サックスとモルガン・スタンレーはコメントを控えた。

スペースＸはコメント要請に応じなかった。

items.title: ＣＯＰ３１、合意文書採択できず閉幕　化石燃料巡りＥＵなど反対
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sarah McFarlane　Peter Hobson

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Sarah McFarlane　Peter Hobson

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催されていた国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが示した最終合意案を欧州連合（ＥＵ）などが拒否し、合意案を採択できないまま閉幕した。ＥＵなどは、合意案が地球温暖化対策を前進させるには不十分だとした。

合意を採択できなかったのは、２００９年にデンマークのコペンハーゲンで開かれたＣＯＰ１５以来となる。

議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は、「もう打つ手はない。われわれはできる限りのことをした」と述べ、新たな文書は提示しないと表明した。

交渉議長を務めたオーストラリアのクリス・ボーウェン気候変動・エネルギー担当相は、化石燃料と気候資金を巡る意見の相違が合意の障害になったと説明し、「非常に残念だ」と述べた。

国連のグテレス事務総長も「気候危機が求める局面に各国政府が立ち向かうと期待していた全ての人々の非常に深い失望を、私も共有している」と述べた。

２０１５年のパリ協定は、気温の上昇を産業革命前と比較して１．５度に抑えるという努力目標を盛り込んだが、当時の予測では、既存の政策のままだと今世紀の気温上昇は約４度に達するとされていた。それから１０年たった現在、予測は２．８度となっている。国連環境計画（ＵＮＥＰ）は９月に発表した報告書で、産業革命以前からの気温上昇が今後数年以内に１．５度を超えると予測した。

＜化石燃料への言及なし＞

交渉を主導したオーストラリアと開催国トルコは、合意文書の草案を複数回示し、気候変動の影響を最も受けやすい国々と、化石燃料の生産や消費に経済を頼る国々の間で妥協点を探った。

２２日に示された最終草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認めた上で、上限を超えた分を最終的に元に戻すため、二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）除去技術の開発を急ぐよう求めた。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

今年下半期のＥＵ議長国アイルランドのダラ・オブライエン環境相は、最終草案不支持の理由として、科学者が地球温暖化の原因と指摘する化石燃料に全く触れていないことなどを挙げた。

パナマも、気候危機の規模と緊急性に応えていないとして、草案を支持できないとした。

関係者の話では、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国が、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけたという。

最終草案には、世界の最終エネルギー消費に占める電力の割合（電化率）を、現在の約２３％から２０３５年までに３５％に引き上げるというトルコの提案も盛り込まれた。

電化率の引き上げ賛成派は、燃料を使う自動車や暖房炉などの機器からの移行が速まり、温室効果ガスの排出を減らせると主張した。一方、批判派は、化石燃料からの脱却に向けた明確な道筋を示さないまま、貧しい国々により多くのコストを負わせる恐れがあると指摘した。

途上国は、温暖化への適応を支援する気候資金が不十分だと批判した。草案は同資金の３倍増を求めたが、どの水準を基準とするかは明記していなかった。

今回、政治宣言に合意できなかったとしても、過去の国連会議で合意された義務が消えるわけではない。ベルギーのジャンリュック・クリュック気候相は、厳しい結果だが「多国間主義の終わりではない」と述べた。

Exclusive-Like SpaceX, Anthropic ran an unusual IPO process, chafing some bankers

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 22 : For the second time this year, Wall Street bankers and lawyers took home a massive paycheck from a record-setting initial public offering. And for the second time this year, some of them came out of it complaining in private about how the process was riddled with complications and unlike any they had worked on before.
With SpaceX’s IPO in June, in which banks earned half a billion dollars in fees, bankers chafed over how tightly the Elon Musk-led company controlled the months-long process and kept financial and other information private, making it hard for advisers to do their jobs. 
As Anthropic’s IPO, dubbed internally “Project Lantern”, eclipsed SpaceX on Thursday and bankers took home more than half a billion dollars in fees, several people close to the process listed a litany of problems that had plagued the offering process: a compressed timeline, marred by last-minute changes and delays in sharing financial projections; rushed document approvals; and highly unusual restrictions on bankers and concern about leaks — especially after Reuters reported many details from a draft IPO filing weeks before it was made public.
Anthropic, for example, instructed some of its 22 IPO underwriters to limit the number of bankers working on the deal to four, asking the firms to make sure they were senior staff, several people familiar with the matter said. One of the people said the restriction likely came out of fear that information would leak, and that the banks found a way to work around it anyway.

Underlying these complaints is a new power dynamic between technology companies and Wall Street. Companies such as SpaceX, Anthropic — and potentially also OpenAI in the future —  have come to wield enormous power as the transformative potential of artificial intelligence creates a frenzied demand for their shares, and they are wielding it to do things their way. That is upsetting some bankers. But banks and investors appear to have little choice but to play along.
“These companies certainly did have some market power to tell underwriters that it’s not going to be business as usual,” said Jay Ritter, a University of Florida professor emeritus who researches IPOs. “But the big Wall Street firms, I suspect, are still going to be doing things as business as usual for all but maybe OpenAI (after these two deals).”
Ritter added that both SpaceX and Anthropic had negotiated to pay underwriters nothing on the additional shares sold through the greenshoe option. “I don't think most companies are going to be able to demand zero spread on overallotment shares,” he said.
Anthropic, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, the two lead underwriters on the two IPOs, declined to comment.
SpaceX and OpenAI did not respond to requests for comment.
Both SpaceX and Anthropic debuted successfully, raising record amounts of money, and their shares rallied initially. A key part of the underwriters’ job is to market the securities. Thanks to the demand for AI, that was an easy sell — both companies had order books oversubscribed many times over. 
After an initial burst in shares, the trajectories of the two big AI firms diverged. SpaceX climbed to a post-listing peak of $201.80 on June 16 before retreating below its $135 IPO price for the first time in mid-July. Anthropic’s shares closed down 8.5 per cent on Friday after a 17 per cent first-day pop, as a dramatic unraveling of the AI trade showed that even a blockbuster listing could not shake the gloom hanging over the sector.
UNUSUAL NON-COMPETES AND RESTRICTIONS
In the case of SpaceX’s IPO, the people close to the process said Musk’s team dictated terms at every stage. Musk's team told the largest and most powerful US banks — including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley — how to market SpaceX's stock and to whom. It told some banks the specific order sizes they needed to “fill” — in some cases a few billion dollars — and gave them instructions on what types of investors to bring. Banks signed on to underwrite the IPO without being told what they would be paid, the people said.
The underlying current running through Anthropic’s IPO process was what several of the people who spoke to Reuters interpreted as a sense of extreme caution.    
Anthropic asked some senior officers at banks working on its IPO to sign legal documents restricting core members of the transaction team from working with rival companies, including OpenAI, Cursor, DeepSeek and Hugging Face, for six months after it went public, according to the people. 
Banks routinely manage conflicts and protect client confidentiality. But bankers and lawyers said it is rare for an IPO to impose exclusivity this broad, particularly on individual bankers. 
In previous head-to-head IPOs such as those of ridesharing rivals Uber and Lyft, or real estate companies Trulia and Zillow, banks could simply pick a side, in part because the deals were smaller and required fewer banks. 
Anthropic, by contrast, needed a broad syndicate to raise the enormous amount of capital it was seeking. That, some of the people said, explained why Anthropic sought to bind individual bankers with these restrictions. 
One banker who declined to sign on to the agreement said it was a challenge to find people who could promise not to actively cover or engage with Anthropic’s peers, especially as several of those companies pursue their own initial or secondary offerings.  
INFORMATION LEAKS AND LATE NIGHTS 
Some of the restrictions were meant to control leaks of information. 
Nearly four weeks before Anthropic’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, called Form S-1, was made public, Reuters reported on it, revealing details of the company’s financials, risk factors, dealings with other tech companies and other information. 
Anthropic also used a product called NetRoadshow to share information, instead of regular PDFs, with most of the banks underwriting the deal. 
NetRoadshow logs access details, including information such as who has seen the document and looked at which page. Documents on NetRoadshow also had individual bankers’ names as watermarks. 
Leaks continued to surface in the press, but using NetRoadshow complicated bankers' work, including because the platform would not let them save copies of documents, one of the people said.
Anthropic planned to file an updated securities filing, called an S-1A, with the SEC with the price range and to launch the marketing on November 10. To do so, it needed to send a draft to all the banks in its syndicate for them to sign off on it.
The night before it was to happen, a law firm on the deal sent a PDF to the banks about the sale of shares in Canada. But soon it followed with another email asking them to disregard it, saying it “contains incorrect price range and share information,” according to the email, which was seen by Reuters.  
The correct S-1A was then sent via the NetRoadshow platform around 2 a.m. New York time. Banks were told they had several hours to sign off on it before it was filed with the SEC.

items.body:
News
/ U.Today
/ XRP Ledger Loses 60% of Users

XRP Ledger Loses 60% of Users 1 min read

XRPUSD
XRP Ledger's network activity has dropped sharply, losing around 60% of the users it had yesterday. The decline comes amid a serious price correction and increased pressure on the cryptocurrency market. Selling pressure remains high, and the declining number of users is not helping the price.
Fuel for the correction
XRPScan's data showed 250,000 users 24 hours ago, while today's reading shows barely 92,000 users. While the drop is significant, it should not be considered critical on its own. The decline partly reflects a regular weekend slowdown, when traders are generally less active, but it comes alongside the price correction and broader selling pressure.

BITSTAMP:XRPUSDT Chart by TradingView">
The highest point for this metric in November was 300,000, with a monthly average of approximately 200,000 active users. The number of users is a critical metric for the network's health, and a decline toward 100,000 often comes before bullish sentiment among investors. The current drop does not guarantee that sentiment will turn, especially as the price remains under pressure.
Price action remains weak
Apart from the negative on-chain trend, XRP's price performance has also been weak. The price lost roughly 5% from its November 19 close and even fell below the $0.90 price level, which was expected to serve as a foundation for recovery. XRP was around $0.915 on November 22 after closing at $0.9604 three days earlier.
The trend remains bearish, and the decline could become significantly worse.
Few expected a surge in market liquidations so soon, as Bitcoin fell below the $60,000 price level. XRP and other altcoins followed the broader market trend and suffered serious losses.
Interest in the network appears to be weakening as the price correction continues, so this drop in activity is not helping XRP's recovery.
A potential recovery above $0.9 could be the key to a quick rebound. However, the overall trend remains bearish and is unlikely to change unless significant market events occur.

items.title: ＣＯＰ３１議長国が合意文書の新草案、脱化石燃料に直接言及せず　合意不透明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Ali Kucukgocmen

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Ali Kucukgocmen

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催中の国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが合意文書の新たな草案を公表した。各国の代表団が異議を申し立てられるよう数時間の猶予を設定した。合意案の承認手続きを始める会合を２２日中に開く予定だが、先行きは不透明。合意に至らない可能性も出ている。

新草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認める。その上で、超過分を最終的に押し戻すため、炭素除去技術の開発加速を求める。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

協議に詳しい関係筋によると、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国は、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけていたという。

ツバルのマイナ・タリア気候変動相は「まるでサウジと交渉しているようだ」と話した。 サウジ代表はコメントを控えた。

ＣＯＰ３１の議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は「われわれは、全ての締約国が合意できる文案を提示できたと考えている。妥協が見えてきている」と述べた。

しかし匿名を条件に取材に応じた複数の代表団は、合意しないまま会議を終える可能性に言及した。

環境団体「３５０．ｏｒｇ」は、草案が化石燃料に明示的に言及せず、炭素除去技術の推進を訴えている点に失望を表明。団体の幹部、サラ・ショー氏は「炭素回収はオーバーシュート時代で最大級の詐欺で、われわれの指導者はそれにだまされる寸前だ」と批判した。 

二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）を大気中に放出される前に取り込む炭素回収技術については、費用がかさむうえに大規模な実用化が実証されておらず、合意に盛り込めば石油・ガス開発の継続に道を開くことになるとの批判的な指摘も出ている。

Washington governor, union denounce ICE arrests of travellers at Seattle airport

A person holds a sign as people gather for a protest at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers arrested two people boarding an Alaska Airlines flight earlier in the day, in SeaTac, Washington, US on Nov 21, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/David Ryder)

The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport.
The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles. ICE officers conducted an operation to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, who overstayed his visa, the agency said in a statement.
The officers also arrested a second individual, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, who threw hot coffee at them, ICE said in a post on social media. Mejia had also overstayed her visa, ICE said, adding that she would be charged with assaulting a federal officer.
Reuters was not able to identify lawyers for Mendoza or Mejia.

"ICE is completely and totally out of control and today we are confronted with yet more evidence of this," said Governor Bob Ferguson, a Democrat, at a news conference on Saturday.
Video of the incident circulated on social media and news outlets is "horrific" and "chilling", Ferguson said, adding that he told Alaska Airlines representatives that “they need to call on ICE to get out of our airports."
The governor said he would make the same request of every other airline that flies out of Sea-Tac airport.
Alaska Airlines said it is "concerned" by the federal action.
"Alaska Airlines was not provided advance notice of the enforcement action and we are working to understand the circumstances surrounding what occurred," the company said in a statement.
April Sims, president of the Washington State Labor Council called the ICE arrest a "smash-and-grab" action that injected fear and chaos during a delicate time for air travel.
"Just days after our nation experienced widespread disruptions to air travel and flights being grounded, federal agents chose to carry out this operation at one of our busiest airports, during one the busiest travel weeks of the year," Sims said in a statement sent by the union, which includes local chapters representing flight attendants and ground crew at Sea-Tac airport.
Alaska Airlines said many passengers were put on other flights shortly after the incident and the originally scheduled flight departed at 11am.

Source: Reuters/nh

items.title: Oil, gas import bill up 60% in Oct as Brent surges, LPG use declines
items.author: Press Trust of India
items.summary: Direct private LPG imports fell 83.8 per cent in October and 97.3 per cent in April-October. Packed domestic LPG sales by state-run companies fell 11.8 per cent in October, and bulk LPG sales fell ...
items.body: India's net oil and gas import bill rose 60 per cent year-on-year to $16 billion in October as Brent crude averaged $124.77 a barrel, almost double that of a year earlier, according to data from the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC), part of the oil ministry.The net bill was $10.0 billion in October 2025. Crude imports alone cost $19.5 billion, against $10.4 billion a year ago, even though volumes rose only 11 per cent to 23.3 million tonnes. LNG imports cost $1.3 billion, and petroleum product exports brought in $6.3 billion.Brent averaged $116.77 in September and $64.75 in October 2025. The Indian basket averaged $119.91 in October, against $65.08 a year earlier.Over April-October, the net import bill reached $97.7 billion, up from $70.3 billion a year earlier. Crude imports rose 2.7 per cent in volume but cost $111.0 billion, against $72.3 billion.Consumption of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) fell 12.3 per cent in October and 15.1 per cent in April-October. The number of active domestic LPG customers stood at 32.6 crore on November 1, down from 33.4 crore on April 1, the PPAC data showed.Direct private LPG imports fell 83.8 per cent in October and 97.3 per cent in April-October. Packed domestic LPG sales by state-run companies fell 11.8 per cent in October, and bulk LPG sales fell 49.1 per cent. Auto LPG sales rose 23.9 per cent.Imports of petroleum products fell 41.2 per cent in October and 49.3 per cent in the fiscal year so far. PPAC attributed the fiscal-year decline mainly to lower imports of LPG, pet coke and fuel oil.The International Energy Agency said in its World Energy Outlook 2026 that LPG imports fell by over 50 per cent in the first two months of shipping disruption through the Strait of Hormuz.Other fuels held up better. Diesel consumption rose 12 per cent in October to 8.5 million tonnes, petrol rose 3.5 per cent, and bitumen rose 16.5 per cent. Total petroleum product consumption rose 2.7 per cent to 20.5 million tonnes in October. It was still down 3.2 per cent in April-October at 134.2 million tonnes.Natural gas consumption fell 7.27 per cent to 5,707 million standard cubic metres in October. LNG imports fell 6.94 per cent to 3,014 million standard cubic metres.India processed 24.1 million tonnes of crude in October, up 7.1 per cent, or about 5.70 million barrels a day. Of that, 22.0 million tonnes were imported crude, and domestic output was 2.1 million tonnes. Imports met 88.7 per cent of crude consumption in October.Domestic crude and condensate output was 2.3 million tonnes. Import dependency for natural gas stood at 52.8 per cent in October.Ethanol blending in petrol stood at 20 per cent in October, PPAC data showed.

items.title: ＥＵ加盟国はロシア人の入国制限強化を、デンマークが提案　暗殺未遂受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - デンマークは、米ウクライナ二重国籍の男性ラッパーに対するロシアの暗殺計画を阻止したと発表したのに続き、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に文書を送り、ロシア国民への入国制限を強化するよう呼びかけた。外交関係者が文書の内容を確認した。

デンマークの警察と治安当局は２０日、ロシア情報機関が９月下旬にコペンハーゲンで公演を控えていた男性ラッパーの暗殺を企てたが、直前に関係する３人を逮捕したと明らかにした。ラスムセン外相はこれを「容認できない」と非難し、デンマーク政府はロシアの駐在武官の国外追放も発表した。

デンマークはＥＵ加盟国の外交担当者に２０日夜に送った文書で、欧州域内の自由な往来を保障するシェンゲン協定締結２９カ国への入国に関し、ロシア国民への観光ビザ（査証）の発給停止や、ロシアの非生体認証パスポートでの本人確認を停止することを提案した。

週明け２３日に開かれるＥＵの事務レベルの会議で提案を示す見通し。

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝クリッパーズ3連敗、八村19得点8リバウンドも及ばず
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は２１日、各地で試合を行い、八村塁が所属するクリッパーズはマーベリックスに１００─１１０で敗れた。

先発した八村は約２９分プレーし、１９得点、８リバウンド、１アシストだった。クリッパーズは３連敗。

セブンティシクサーズはバックスを１３２─１２９で下し、５連勝。東カンファレンストップの１４勝３敗とした。シクサーズのジョエル・エンビードが２６得点、１７リバウンド、９アシストと活躍。レブロン・ジェームズが２１得点、６リバウンド、６アシスト、３スチールで貢献した。バックスはタイラー・ヒーローがキャリア最多の５０得点を挙げたが、１３連敗となった。

スパーズはビクター・ウェンバンヤマが５０得点、１９リバウンドと活躍し、ペリカンズに１１４─９１で快勝した。ティンバーウルブズはグリズリーズに１０４─９５で勝利。ニックスはトレイルブレーザーズに９７─９６で競り勝った。

items.title: テニス＝ＡＴＰファイナル、決勝はズベレフ対アルカラス
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの今季ツアー最終戦、ＡＴＰファイナルは２１日、イタリアのトリノで準決勝を行い、決勝は世界ランキング１位のアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と世界３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）という顔合わせになった。

ズベレフは第４シードでロシア出身のダニル・メドベージェフと対戦し、第１セットはタイブレークで７ポイントを連取して７─６でものにすると、第２セットは６─４で勝利。今大会では１セットも落とさずに決勝まで進んだ。

自身３回目のＡＴＰファイナル制覇を目指すズベレフは「どちらも信じられないほど素晴らしいサーブを打っていたので、（ブレークポイントは）ほとんどなかったような気がする。彼（メドベージェフ）をたたえたい」と話した。

アルカラスは第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）に３─６、６─３、７─６で逆転勝利。「第２セットでいいプレーをして巻き返せたのがとにかくうれしい。タイブレークでも素晴らしいテニスができて満足している。この勝利には大きな意味がある。明日が楽しみだ。今日は全てに満足している」と話した。

アルカラスは優勝すればＡＴＰファイナル初タイトル。ズベレフとの対戦成績は７勝６敗としており、ことしの全豪オープン準決勝でもフルセットの末に勝利を収めている。

items.title: サッカー＝レアル、エムバペＰＫ失敗もセルタに逆転勝ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２１日、各地で試合を行い、レアル・マドリードがセルタに２─１で勝利し、翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと暫定ながら勝ち点３３で並んだ。

前半６分に失点したレアルは、同３９分にキリアン・エムバペが自ら得たＰＫで同点のチャンスを得るも、これを失敗。同選手がレアルとフランス代表での試合中にＰＫを外したのは直近６回中これが３回目となった。

レアルは後半２１分、エムバペのアシストからジュード・ベリンガムが同点弾をマークすると、同４０分にカルロス・エスピが決勝ゴールを決めた。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアはラヨ・バリェカノに１─０で勝利し、暫定１７位に浮上して降格圏内を脱出。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

その他、セビリアとベティスのダービーは１─１のドロー。アラベスはデポルティボに３─１で勝利した。

items.title: ノルディックスキー＝Ｗ杯ジャンプ個人第1戦で小林陵8位、丸山9位
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - ノルディックスキーのワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）ジャンプは２１日、リレハンメルで男女の個人第１戦（ヒルサイズ＝ＨＳ１４０メートル）を行い、男子では小林陵侑が８位だった。

小林は１回目に１３５メートル、２回目に１２６．５メートルを飛び、合計２４４．２点だった。シュテファン・エンバハー（オーストリア）が合計２７８．０点で優勝した。中村直幹は１１位、佐藤幸椰は２３位。二階堂蓮は２回目に進めず、３７位に終わった。

女子では丸山希が合計２１６．８点で９位。宮嶋林湖は１１位、勢藤優花は１４位、伊藤有希は１９位で、高梨沙羅は２回目に進めずに３５位だった。優勝したアイリンマリア・クバンダルを含め、５位までノルウェー勢が独占した。

items.title: ラグビー＝ネーションズ選手権、日本はスコットランドに大敗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ - ラグビーの強豪１２カ国・地域で争う国際大会、ネーションズ選手権は２１日、英国のエディンバラなどで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同６位のスコットランド代表に５─６７で大敗した。

日本はスピードとパワーで圧倒され、合計１１トライを献上。前半に０─２９と大差をつけられると、後半にも失点を重ね、松永拓朗による１トライにとどまった。

同大会では北半球と南半球のチームが戦い、南の一員として参戦している日本は１勝５敗で５位。北のスコットランドは４勝２敗で４位となった。

エディー・ジョーンズ・ヘッドコーチ率いる日本は１１月に入って３戦全敗。７日はウェールズに２１─２８で敗れ、１４日はイングランドに１５─７８の完敗を喫していた。

items.title: サッカー＝坂元が強烈ミドルで今季2点目、コベントリーがパレス下す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２１日、各地で試合を行い、坂元達裕がフル出場したコベントリーが鎌田大地フル出場のクリスタルパレスに３─２で競り勝った。

コベントリーは１─１と追い付かれて迎えた前半３０分、ペナルティーエリアの外でボールを受けた坂元が胸トラップから左足で強烈なミドルシュートをたたき込み、リーグ戦今季２ゴール目。チームは同アディショナルタイムに再び同点とされたが、最後は相手のオウンゴールで勝利を収めた。

最下位のクリスタルパレスはこれで今季８敗目。トーマス・フランク監督の初陣を白星で飾ることができなかった。クリスタルパレスの冨安健洋はベンチ外。

田中碧が先発したリーズはチェルシーを４─１で撃破。前半２５分に先制されたが、ノア・オカフォーの２ゴールなどで逆転勝利を収めた。チェルシーはリーグ戦直近４試合で３敗目となった。田中は後半４１分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはサンダーランドとスコアレスドローに終わった。前田大然が先発し後半１１分までプレーしたイプスウィッチは、トットナムに０─２で完敗した。

アーセナルはニューカッスルと２─２の引き分けに終わり、勝ち点を積み上げるチャンスを逸した。マンチェスター・シティーはフラムと１─１のドローで試合を終え、リーグ戦４連敗を免れた。

１１試合消化時点で首位アーセナルは勝ち点２８。リーズは同１７として６位に浮上した。コベントリーは同１２で１３位となった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -

［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、男子では友野一希が合計２３７．７５点で３位に入った。

前日のショートプログラム（ＳＰ）で５位だった友野は、この日に行われたフリーでは４位だった。

items.title: メキシコ、麻薬組織の首領を拘束　米当局が協力
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] - メキシコ当局は２１日、軍が２０日夜に麻薬組織の首領ファウスト・イシドロ・メサフロレス容疑者（通称エル・チャポ・イシドロ）を北西部シナロア州で拘束したと発表した。容疑者は米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）の最重要指名手配者１０人の一人。

メキシコ国防省はＸへの投稿で、軍の特殊部隊と国家警備隊による拘束作戦には米国の情報機関も協力したと明らかにした。メキシコ政府はトランプ米政権の圧力を受け、麻薬組織の取り締まりを強化している。

米国務省によると、メサフロレス容疑者とその麻薬組織「ベルトラン・レイバ」は２０年以上にわたり、ヘロイン、メタンフェタミン、コカイン、マリフアナ（大麻）を米国へ大量に密輸してきた。内部抗争が起きている別の麻薬組織「シナロア・カルテル」の派閥の一つと協力関係にあるという。

米国土安全保障捜査局（ＨＳＩ）はＸで、この作戦が「メキシコで最も強力なカルテルネットワークの一つに重大な打撃を与えた」と投稿。米北方軍もメキシコ軍を称えた。

Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks

The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.

Visitors walk in front of Matam Rajab in downtown Manama, Bahrain, Nov 6, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. (File photo: REUTERS/Hamad I Mohammed)

FAST

Bahrain said on Saturday (Nov 21) that an Iranian attack had hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched a missile-and-drone attack on US military positions in the kingdom, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet.
The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February. Since then, Gulf Arab states have been drawn into the conflict, and there have been repeated Iranian attacks across the region.
Civil Defence teams were working to contain the fire at the industrial facility, the ministry said in a post on X. It gave no details on the location or nature of the site.
Bahrain's interior ministry initially issued an alert urging residents to move to the nearest safe location because of a potential threat, without providing details. It later issued an all-clear before sending a second alert.

Later, Bahrain's Defence Force said its air defences had intercepted a number of Iranian aerial attacks. Shrapnel from the interceptions caused material damage but no casualties, it said, adding that Tehran was continuing its "systematic hostile approach" towards the kingdom.
The Revolutionary Guards, in a statement carried by Iranian state news agency IRNA, said their aerospace forces had launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases "in retaliation for ongoing aggression and repeated violations of Iranian airspace".
US Central Command did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the Guards' account.
Bahrain has reported intercepting several Iranian aerial attacks in recent days. Gulf Arab states have come under repeated fire from Tehran since the war broke out.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフの今季最終戦、ＣＭＥツアー選手権は２１日、フロリダ州ネープルズのティブロンＧＣ（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、吉田優利が２位に浮上した。

３位でスタートした吉田は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６６をマーク。通算１７アンダーの１９９に伸ばし、単独首位の金阿林（韓国）とは１打差につけた。

岩井明愛は５バーディー、ノーボギーの６７でラウンドし、通算１５アンダーの６位に浮上。山下美夢有も６７で回り、通算１４アンダーの７位に順位を上げた。

竹田麗央は通算１２アンダーの１５位。西郷真央と古江彩佳は通算８アンダーの２６位。西村優菜は通算６アンダーの３３位。岩井千怜と勝みなみは３７位、原英莉花と畑岡奈紗は４４位となった。

items.title: Ｆ１＝ラスベガスＧＰ予選、フェルスタッペンがＰＰ獲得
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ラスベガス　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ラスベガス　２０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第２１戦、ラスベガス・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２０日、予選を行い、マックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ、レッドブル）がポールポジション（ＰＰ）を獲得した。

総合優勝４回を誇るフェルスタッペンのＰＰ獲得は今季３回目で、キャリア通算５１回目。

すでに史上最年少での総合優勝を決めているキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が最速タイムを計測したが、エンジン関連のペナルティーで５グリッド降格し、決勝では６番手からスタートする。

これを受けて、２番手のフェルスタッペン、３番手のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）、４番手のランド・ノリス（英国、マクラーレン）、５番手のアイザック・ハジャー（フランス、レッドブル）、６番手のアービッド・リンドブラッド（英国、レーシングブルズ）がそれぞれ１つずつ繰り上がる。

items.title: Vietnam’s New Land Law Could Speed Up Priority Projects but Weaken Farmers’ Bargaining Power
items.summary: Vietnam’s revised land law, effective July 2027, could speed up priority projects by allowing some land acquisition decisions before compensation plans are approved. The change could weaken farmers’ ...
items.body:
Vietnam’s New Land Law Could Speed Up Priority Projects but Weaken Farmers’ Bargaining Power Vietnam’s revised land law, effective July 2027, could speed up priority projects by allowing some land acquisition decisions before compensation plans are approved. The change could weaken farmers’ bargaining power, putting pressure on provincial authorities to value land fairly, resolve objections and pay households on time.
Devdiscourse News Desk | Updated: 22-11-2026 13:53 IST | Created: 22-11-2026 13:53 IST

Representative Image.

Country:

Vietnam

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Vietnam's National Assembly approved a revised land law on November 21, giving authorities a faster route to acquire land for certain projects. The law generally takes effect on July 1, 2027, and was passed with 466 of 479 participating deputies voting in favour. For Vietnam, the potential gain is more predictable delivery of infrastructure and industrial projects. For farmers and other land users, the change raises a more immediate question: how much influence will they have over compensation once authorities can issue an acquisition decision before the payment plan is final?

Faster land clearance could give Vietnam more predictable project timelines
Land disputes can delay projects when households challenge compensation offers they consider below market value. The revised law addresses one source of delay by changing the order of decisions. In eligible cases, authorities can issue a land acquisition decision before approving the compensation plan. An earlier National Assembly resolution already allowed accelerated land recovery in some circumstances, including for nationally important projects ordered to proceed faster and urgent public investment projects. The revised law builds on that approach.

For public agencies and developers, earlier decisions could make it easier to coordinate site preparation, construction contracts and financing. The economic gain depends on whether sites actually become available sooner. If disputes over valuation or payment carry over into later stages, the time saved on the acquisition decision could be offset by delays before construction begins.

Farmers could lose bargaining power before compensation is settled
Farmland is especially exposed because a household can lose its source of income without having to move. Chris Luong, a partner at CNC Counsel, said the faster procedure could therefore matter more for agricultural plots than for residential property. For farmers, the practical questions are how long they can keep using their land, when compensation arrives and whether a replacement plot can sustain production.

Two consent rules matter here. The earlier implementing decree identifies a route to an acquisition decision before compensation approval when more than 75% of land users agree. Reporting on the adopted law describes a separate mechanism for recovering the remaining land in a negotiated project after an investor has secured agreements covering more than 75% of both the land area and the land users. The distinction matters to developers assembling a site and to households that remain in negotiations after most neighbours have agreed.

Provincial authorities face the hardest decisions on compensation
Vietnam's government says the law gives priority to compensation in land with the same use as the land acquired. It also provides for other forms of compensation, including housing or cash, subject to the circumstances and what is available locally. That makes provincial capacity consequential. A same-use plot can help a farming household keep earning, while a cash award leaves the household to find replacement land or another source of income. The options will vary with local land supply.

Policymakers also face a timing issue. The law generally takes effect in July 2027, while the new land price schedules and adjustment coefficients are due to apply from January 1, 2028. For cases that span those dates, households and investors will need clarity on which valuation rules apply. Publishing the basis for each offer and the route for challenging it would help land users assess compensation and give developers a clearer view of likely costs.

The first cases will show whether faster decisions deliver fairer outcomes
Hanoi's proposed $28 billion Red River redevelopment shows how much can turn on compensation. Bloomberg reported that about 280,000 people live in the area covered by the project and that city officials proposed higher payments amid resistance. The dispute illustrates the stakes when a project affects homes, livelihoods and neighbourhood ties at the same time. Whether any part of the project can use an accelerated procedure depends on the applicable acquisition and resettlement rules.

The first cases under the revised law should show how provinces record consent, handle objections and sequence possession and payment. For Vietnam, the measure of success is whether priority projects reach construction sooner. For affected households, it is whether they receive compensation and livelihood support in time to replace what they lose. Tracking both outcomes would show whether the reform resolves delays or shifts their cost onto land users.

items.title: フィギュア＝フィンランディア杯、女子の島田2連勝でファイナル進出
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、女子では島田麻央が第２戦のスケートカナダに続く２連勝を達成。シリーズ上位６人で争われるＧＰファイナル（中国・重慶で１２月１０─１２日に開催）初進出を決めた。

ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）首位の島田は、この日のフリーでは冒頭のトリプルアクセル（３回転半ジャンプ）に成功。さらにステップやスピンで最高難度のレベル４を獲得するなどし、合計２２９．４９点をマークした。

日本選手によるＧＰデビューからの２連勝は２０１８年の紀平梨花以来で、２人目となった。今季ＧＰシリーズでは日本勢が５戦全勝。第１戦と第４戦では中井亜美、第３戦では千葉百音が優勝した。

ニーナ・ペトロキナ（エストニア）が合計２１４．０６点で２位、イザボー・レビト（米国）が合計２０７．１９点で３位に入った。住吉りをんは７位、渡辺倫果は１０位に終わった。

items.title: Google pledges $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research
items.summary: Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to strengthen advanced artificial intelligence (AI) research, expand educational opportunities and develop the next generation of technology ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / Google pledges $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research

Google pledges $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research The announcement was made during the institute's platinum jubilee celebrations on November 21

The funding will primarily support applied AI research in areas such as Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology (Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India Kolkata 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 22 2026 | 1:39 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to strengthen advanced artificial intelligence (AI) research, expand educational opportunities and develop the next generation of technology professionals, a senior institute official said on Sunday.
The announcement was made during the institute's platinum jubilee celebrations on November 21.
IIT Kharagpur Director Suman Chakraborty told PTI that Sundar Pichai, an alumnus and CEO of Google, played a key role in facilitating the funding for IIT Kharagpur.
" We are proud of him (Sundar Pichai) as an alumnus who heads Google. We are thankful to Google for pledging the money, and Pichai assisted in IIT Kharagpur getting the money," he said.
  The funding will primarily support applied AI research in areas such as Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology.
Also Read

The grant will be channelled through three broad areas -- advanced AI research, educational opportunities, including expansion of AI training and curriculum for students and faculty, and capacity building through the development of campus AI infrastructure, frameworks and tools.
The director said another alumnus, Jyoti Chatterjee, had pledged an additional $5 million as seed endowment for developing a next-generation data initiative.
"The contributions are expected to provide a major boost to the institute's efforts to expand AI-driven innovation and enhance its role in developing skilled technology professionals," he said.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: イラン、バーレーンの工業施設攻撃、2人負傷　「米軍施設標的」と革命防衛隊
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - バーレーンは２１日、民間の工業施設がイランの攻撃を受け火災が発生したと発表した。イランの精鋭部隊、イスラム革命防衛隊は、バーレーン国内の米軍陣地に対しミサイルと無人機による攻撃を実施したと表明した。

バーレーンには米海軍第５艦隊が拠点があり、ここ１週間、イランの攻撃を複数回受けている。

バーレーン内務省は２２日、前日のイランによる攻撃で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。パキスタン人が重体でバーレーン市民は容体は安定していると説明した。

同省は２１日、具体的内容には触れず、潜在的な脅威があるとして住民に避難を呼びかける警報を発令。警報はいったん解除されたが、再び出された。

その後、バーレーン国防軍は、防空部隊がイランによる複数の空中攻撃を迎撃したと発表した。迎撃による破片で物的被害が出たものの、死傷者の報告はないとした。国防軍は、イラン政府がバーレーンに対する「組織的な敵対的アプローチ」を続けていると指摘した。

一方、イランの革命防衛隊は国営イラン通信（ＩＲＮＡ）が伝えた声明で、「継続的な侵略とイラン領空への度重なる侵犯に対する報復」として、リファー基地およびアワリ基地の米軍施設に対し、宇宙航空部隊がミサイルと無人機による複合攻撃を実施したと発表した。

米中央軍は、革命防衛隊の説明に関するロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

items.title: ロシア貨物船に無人機攻撃、ウクライナ関与か　フィンランド領海で火災
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシア軍と関係のあるロシアの貨物船が２１日、バルト海で無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受けて火災を起こした。フィンランド沿岸警備隊は２２日、消火活動が行われているものの夜間を通じて燃え続けていると発表した。フィンランド軍は、攻撃はウクライナが実行した可能性が高いとの見解を示している。

貨物船は「スパルタ２」。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ロシア国防省向けに物流サービスを提供しているロシアの海運会社オボロンロジスティカが所有する。米国の制裁対象になっている。

フィンランド軍によると、スパルタ２はロシア領ゴーグラント島の西の公海上で攻撃を受けて損傷し、フィンランド領海内に漂流した。現在も領海内でいかりを下ろしている。乗組員１６人は近くにいたロシア船に避難した。

ウクライナは今年に入り、ロシア北西部レニングラード州に向けて軍用無人機による波状攻撃を繰り返している。一部の無人機はバルト海地域の領空に入り込み、戦争が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の領域に影響を及ぼしているとの懸念が出ている。

オルポ首相はＸに「戦争が近隣地域に波及しつつある。フィンランド当局は、無人機攻撃でロシアの商船が被弾したフィンランド湾の状況に対応している。ウクライナには侵略者と戦う権利がある」と投稿した。

エストニアのミハル首相はＸに「ロシアの侵略と戦うことの影響がバルト海に及んだ。侵略者に（侵略を）やめるよう求める新たなシグナルだ。だが、われわれのウクライナ支援を止めるものは何もない」と投稿した。

エストニア海軍司令官のイボ・バルク氏は２２日、フィンランド湾でさらなる攻撃が行われるリスクは排除できないと公共放送ＥＲＲに語った。

items.title: Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security
items.author: CNA
items.summary: “The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.
items.body:

Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security

“The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.

The damaged Russian cargo ship Sparta II, in a location given as the Gulf of Finland, November 21, 2026. FINNISH BORDER GUARD/Handout via REUTERS

HELSINKI: A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday ( Nov 21) and later drifted into Finnish waters, prompting Helsinki to impose temporary air and maritime restrictions and say Ukraine was probably behind the attack.
The Sparta II, bound for Russian exclave Kaliningrad , was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland 's Defence Forces said, corroborating an earlier account by Russian officials.
"It is likely that Ukraine...is behind (the attack)," Finnish armed forces spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen told a press conference, adding it was not clear why the vessel had been targeted.
Finland 's Border Guard said there was no danger to maritime traffic or people, that rescue units were at the scene, and that it was coordinating operations with neighbouring countries.

Gulf of Finland coast guard commander Mikko Simola later told a press conference the vessel had anchored and its crew was evacuating.
Helsinki said it had introduced temporary aviation and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland to protect civilians and allow authorities to operate if drones needed to be intercepted.
"The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas. Finnish authorities are handling the situation in the Gulf of Finland , where a drone strike has hit a Russian merchant vessel. Ukraine has the right to fight against the aggressor," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said on X.
Ukraine's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Russia's embassy in Helsinki did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The vessel is subject to US sanctions and is linked to Russian ship ping company Oboronlogistika, according to the US Treasury Department.
Oboronlogistika provides logistics services for the Russian defence ministry, according to the company's website.
"At the moment, there is no confirmed information about what cargo is on board, but it cannot be ruled out that there is military materiel on board," Finnish Border Guard Commander Ilja Iljin told Reuters.
Helsinki said separately that a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace on Saturday, possibly in connection with rescue or monitoring operations involving the damaged vessel.

Related:

RUSSIA SAYS DRONES SHOT DOWN OVER LENINGRAD REGION Leningrad region Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said on Telegram that a cargo vessel had been attacked by two drones in international waters about 3 nautical miles from Russia's border. He did not identify the vessel.
Drozdenko also said 80 drones had been shot down over the Leningrad region overnight.
Finland 's military said last week it had detected a strike on a Russian war ship in the same area during a wave of Ukrainian drone attacks on the Leningrad region.
Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson said on X his country was monitoring the situation and had offered assistance to Finland , without providing details.
Estonia's Police and Border Guard Board said in an emailed statement that preliminary information indicated there had been explosions on board the Sparta II, and that it was also monitoring the situation.
Kaliningrad Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said the incident posed no threat to supplies to the region.
Kaliningrad , which lies between Poland and Lithuania, has periodically been a flashpoint between Russia and NATO and the European Union.
Russia has previously described attacks on its commercial vessels outside its territorial waters as acts of terrorism and maritime piracy.
The Sparta II is a 121-metre Russian-flagged cargo vessel owned by Oboronlogistika that left St Petersburg on Friday, according to LSEG data.
The Gulf of Finland is a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea between Finland and Estonia that extends east to St Petersburg. Gogland lies in the eastern Gulf of Finland , about 40 km from Finland 's coast.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: ＡＢＢロボット事業、ソフトバンクＧへの売却頓挫なら上場も　中国阻止で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anousha Sakoui　Oliver Hirt　John Revill

［ロンドン／チューリッヒ　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Anousha Sakoui　Oliver Hirt　John Revill

［ロンドン／チューリッヒ　２０日　ロイター］ - スイスの重電大手ＡＢＢが、ソフトバンクグループ（ＳＢＧ）に売却する予定のロボット事業について、中国が売却計画を阻止したことを受け、計画が白紙になった場合に上場させることを検討していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

中国当局の阻止は、ＳＢＧと欧米企業との関係や、機密データが米国に移転されるリスクを懸念したためとされる。ＳＢＧはオープンＡＩの主要投資家となっている。

関係者によると、ＡＢＢとＳＢＧは計画の修正に取り組んでおり、ロボット事業の約３０％を占める中国事業を切り離し、中国企業に売却するか上場させる案が出ている。それがうまくいかなければ、ＡＢＢはロボット事業をスピンオフ（分離・独立）するか、別の相手に売却することを視野に置いている。

ただ、両社は取引の成立を最優先に考えているという。今後数週間で打開策を見出したいと考えているが、協議は２０２７年にずれ込む可能性もあると関係者は話した。

関係者の１人によると、ＳＢＧは違約金を負う可能性がある。違約金の条件は開示されていない。

ＡＢＢとＳＢＧはコメントを控えた。

中国政府は、ＡＩ開発の主導権を巡る米国との競争が激しくなる中、最先端技術が絡む買収案件を厳格に審査している。４月には米メタが、ＡＩスタートアップのＭａｎｕｓ（マナス）買収の撤回を命じられた。

ＡＢＢは中国の１３０近い都市で約３０の現地法人を運営し、従業員は１万５０００人に上る。同社のウェブサイトによると、ＡＢＢエンジニアリング（上海）にはロボット事業のグローバル本部が置かれ、重要な研究開発・生産拠点になっている。

ＳＢＧは１０月初旬にＡＢＢのロボット事業買収を発表した際、買収によって「当社のＡＩロボット事業を飛躍的に強化する」と説明していた。破談となれば打撃となる。

items.title: "Going to be permanent": Trump on making a deal with Iran
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Saturday said that any potential agreement with Iran would be "permanent" and aimed at preventing Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons, reiterating his insistence on ...
items.body:
"Going to be permanent": Trump on making a deal with Iran US President Donald Trump on Saturday said that any potential agreement with Iran would be "permanent" and aimed at preventing Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons, reiterating his insistence on securing what he described as a genuine and lasting deal with the country.
ANI | Updated: 21-11-2026 22:02 IST | Created: 21-11-2026 22:02 IST

US President Donald Trump (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US President Donald Trump on Saturday said that any potential agreement with Iran would be "permanent" and aimed at preventing Tehran from acquiring nuclear weapons, reiterating his insistence on securing what he described as a genuine and lasting deal with the country. "I'm going to make a deal that is going to be permanent. I’m not going to let somebody allow them to have a nuclear weapon," Trump said, expressing his determination to ensure that Iran does not develop nuclear weapons.
In an interview with Fox News, Trump also said he had never been particularly interested in regime change in Iran while describing his attacks on the country's senior leadership as a significant shift for the Iranian regime. He characterised Iran's new leadership as "more rational", but questioned its reliability in negotiations, alleging that Tehran had a history of making agreements and subsequently breaking them.
The latest remarks come amid continuing tensions between Washington and Tehran, with Trump repeatedly expressing dissatisfaction over the terms Iran has been willing to offer in negotiations. Earlier on Friday, following his visit to China, Trump launched a sharp criticism of Tehran, accusing Iran of misleading people for decades and insisting that any agreement with Washington must meet US expectations.
Speaking at a press conference, the US President linked fluctuations in gasoline prices to the outcome of negotiations with Iran, arguing that Tehran wanted an agreement but had not offered terms acceptable to him. "The prices of gasoline now, that also depends on how we settle up with Iran. They want to make a deal, but they don't want to make a deal that's acceptable to me. We want to make a real deal, not a fake deal that they've been doing for 51 years. No longer 47. People talk 47. It's 51 years," Trump said.
Taking a further swipe at Tehran, Trump accused Iran of misleading people over the past five decades, remarking, "They've been bullsh***ing people for 51 years." Trump's latest comments underscore his continued push for an agreement that would prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons, while maintaining that Washington would not accept a deal that falls short of its expectations.
His remarks come amid continuing tensions in West Asia, with Washington weighing its options regarding Iran, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has reportedly urged the US administration to consider renewed military action against Tehran. While Trump has indicated that he is seeking a lasting diplomatic agreement, his statements also reflect his continued criticism of Iran's negotiating approach and the terms offered by Tehran. (ANI)

items.title: 米ＦＢＩの犯罪情報データベースにハッキング、ＣＮＮ報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２０日 ロイター] - ＣＮＮは２０日、関係筋２人の話として、連邦、州、地方の法執行機関が刑事司法情報を共有するために使用する全国規模のデータベースへの不正アクセスが疑われる件について、米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）が捜査を行っていると報じた。

全米犯罪情報センター（ＮＣＩＣ）のデータベースが侵害されたとみられるこの事案は、ここ数カ月でＦＢＩのシステムに関する２件目の侵入となる。９月にはＦＢＩの求人サイトが不正アクセスを受け、現職員および元職員のデータが流出した。

ＦＢＩはロイターのコメント要請に応じなかった。

ＦＢＩのデータベースは、令状、犯罪歴、身元調査に関する情報を保存・共有するために、全国の法執行機関によって利用されている。

items.title: 孫正義氏、ＳＫハイニックスの1兆ドル買収を一時検討＝メディア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２０日 ロイター] - ニュースメディア「ジ・インフォメーション」は２０日、事情に詳しい複数の関係筋の話として、ソフトバンクグループの孫正義最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が最近、韓国の半導体メモリー大手ＳＫハイニックスを１兆ドル規模で買収する可能性について、ウォール街の金融機関に資金調達を打診したと報じた。

同メディアによると、ソフトバンクＧの広報担当者は「当社は多くの機会を模索している。この件についてはもはや積極的に検討していない」と述べた。

一方、ＳＫハイニックスは声明で、ジ・インフォメーションの報道で言及された件については承知していないと述べた。

また、韓国法に基づき、自社に対する海外企業による買収には事前の政府承認が必要になると付け加えた。

ソフトバンクＧの広報担当者はロイターのコメント要請に対し、ジ・インフォメーションに提供したコメントを参照するよう求めた。

Nov 21 : Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency by market value, rose more than 8 per cent to around $59,952 on Saturday, after sliding to its lowest level in two years earlier in the day. 
It briefly crossed $60,000 at around 8:30 a.m. EST (1330 GMT). 
Bitcoin had fallen to $55,251.60 earlier in the day, its lowest level in two years, after breaking below $57,742 on Friday for the first time since September 2024 as stretched valuations in artificial intelligence stocks rattled investors and weighed on other risk assets. 
Crypto markets have been shaken in recent sessions by weeks of concern about the profitability of massive AI infrastructure spending, rising borrowing costs, regulatory risks following Democrats' win in the US midterm elections and the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

A stronger dollar, higher real yields and greater market volatility have all created headwinds for cryptocurrencies, with bitcoin increasingly moving in tandem with stocks. 
US stocks extended their rout on Friday, marking one of their steepest weekly declines since April 2025, when President Donald Trump announced "Liberation Day" tariffs.
The S&P 500 and the Dow both confirmed corrections after Anthropic's momentous market debut fell flat, exacerbating worries about the AI trade that has driven this year's stock market rally.

Nov 20 : SoftBank Group CEO Masayoshi Son recently approached Wall Street institutions about financing a possible trillion-dollar "buyout" of South Korean memory chip company SK Hynix, the Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The Information quoted a SoftBank spokesperson as saying Son was no longer considering such a deal. 
“SoftBank explores many opportunities, and this one is no longer under active consideration,” the report said, citing the spokesperson. 
SK Hynix said in a statement it has no knowledge of the matter described in the Information report.
It added that any foreign acquisition of the company would require prior government approval under Korean law.
A SoftBank spokesperson referred to the statement the company gave to the Information, when Reuters sought a comment.

items.title: South Korea's Lee says speed is vital in AI race on data centre visit
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Data centres are a major source of chip demand, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said he hoped the success of the project would draw further investment from global AI companies.

South Korea's Lee says speed is vital in AI race on data centre visit

Data centres are a major source of chip demand, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said he hoped the success of the project would draw further investment from global AI companies. 

South Korean President Lee Jae-myung attends a welcome banquet for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting at the Shenzhen International Communication Center in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, China on Nov 18, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Maxim Shemetov)
